description: A Javadoc comment is added above the flagged method, shifting its line number without touching the method or the flagged line - about as common and as low-stakes a commit as exists, and one naive line-number matching gets wrong every time.

before.snippet: String sql = "SELECT * FROM refunds WHERE id = " + order.getId();
